HOMM3 PERSONAL EDITION v6 — UPLOAD THIS SITE ZIP DIRECTLY

HOMM3-Cloudflare-Upload.zip IS THE FINISHED CLOUDFLARE PAGES UPLOAD.
No preparation scripts, Node.js, npm, Github or local build are needed.

1. Upload HOMM3-Cloudflare-Upload.zip using Cloudflare Pages > Direct Upload.
2. Create a free D1 database. In your Pages project's Settings > Bindings,
   add a D1 binding named DB. Redeploy this same ZIP to apply the binding.
3. Open the website and click Create an account.
4. After creating your account, upload your own installed Heroes III
   Complete / Shadow of Death folder ON THE WEBSITE.
5. On another computer: open the same website and sign in. Your game
   files download into the browser automatically.

No R2 or paid subscription is used. One free D1 database is required.
Game libraries must fit the free limits. Try without optional music if needed.
The original commercial HOMM3 game files are not included in this ZIP.

Save in game, return & sync, and wait for Synced to cloud before changing PCs.
Three Realms: enable the checkbox before playing to add the three towns.

All future releases will be full directly uploadable website ZIPs.
Keep the SAME D1 database to retain accounts, game files and cloud saves.
You can update the existing Pages site; deleting it is not required.
Read CLOUDFLARE-UPLOAD.md for dashboard steps and older-version migration.

NEW IN v6: Check Crown Authority before a NEW game. Earn +3 Authority per
town/day and +5 extra per built Capitol/day. Bring a visiting hero to a town
and click its Fort/Citadel/Castle to issue one of 12 edicts or decrees.
Keep it enabled for Crown saves. Read CROWN-AUTHORITY.md for details.
Source and automatic full-build workflow: github.com/jacksonmatott-cmd/homm3cf
